preparation_limits: Figures and diagrams are not transcribed or interpreted. Each one is cropped and retained, and any whole page can be rendered from the PDF with the `page` command.
Equations appear only as the PDF's raw text layer, which is frequently not faithful.
Multi-level table headers lose their grouping; the data rows are extracted as-is.
Reading order is corrected only where block geometry shows a column jump. It is not proven correct anywhere.
An uncaptioned figure produces no annotation and no crop; it is visible only by rendering its page.
